about_short_description.short_description: Trendster provides an influencer marketing platform that helps brands discover creators, manage campaigns, and track performance metrics.

product.name: Influencer Discovery and Analytics
product.description: A platform feature that allows brands and agencies to find influencers using detailed metrics such as engagement, audience demographics, growth, and optimal posting times.

product.name: Campaign Creation and Management
product.description: A service that enables brands and agencies to define campaign goals, deliverables, schedules, and manage influencer coordination through a dashboard.

product.name: Influencer Compensation Management
product.description: A system that supports multiple payment methods for compensating influencers, including online payment, bank transfer, and check or cash collection.

product.name: Brand Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app that allows brands to receive campaign notifications, approve content, and communicate with influencers on the go.

product.name: Influencer Campaign Application and Communication
product.description: A platform feature that allows influencers to browse and apply for campaigns, communicate with brands, and manage content approvals and scheduling.
